page: Microsoft Azure NG8ads_V620_v1 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the NGADSV620v1 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes a fractional GPU configuration, providing 0.25 of an AMD V620 GPU with 7 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 1222 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

The fractional GPU allocation offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. However, the 2.0 GB of RAM per core represents a potential bottleneck for memory-intensive applications. This hardware profile is designed for light GPU-accelerated tasks, remote desktop hosting, entry-level machine learning inference, and database workloads utilizing the local NVMe SSD.
